what_happened: Confirmed orchestrator-postflight.sh and skill_lifecycle_notify are orphaned for core task types (general/meta/markdown route directly to agents, bypassing the lifecycle-skill layer); this corroborates and explains why hooking the fix into claude-stop-notify.sh's Stop hook is structurally correct rather than a narrower lifecycle-notify.sh fix.

Discovered that lifecycle-notify.sh's .claude/tmp/orchestrate-active marker (described in its own header as the mid-orchestrate TTS suppressor) has zero writers anywhere in the source store -- dead code, separate from the genuinely live workflow-active-<uuid> marker. This is a second gap in the same file the dispatch already requires reconciling; folded into the Recommendations section rather than opened as separate work.

No existing scripts/tests/ file touches claude-stop-notify.sh, tts-notify.sh, or lifecycle-notify.sh at all, and no existing check asserts Notification-matcher parity between merge-sources/settings-hooks.json and root-files/settings.json. Acceptance criteria 2/3/4/6 all require new test/check coverage from scratch, not an extension of existing coverage.
